title: Is Starlink legit? How to find the official site and check who is selling
seoTitle: Is Starlink legit? Official site and scams
description: The official Starlink site and the list of authorized retailers show you who you are buying from. See what to check, and which look-alike profiles to ignore, before you pay.
metaDescription: See how to recognize the official Starlink site, spot look-alike profiles on Trustpilot and check the list of authorized retailers.
imageAlt: A Starlink dish mounted on a pole in front of mountains. The cover asks “Is it legit?”.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, Starlink is legit: it is SpaceX's official satellite internet service, and it sells directly on starlink.com. We subscribed to Starlink ourselves as an alternative to unstable local fiber. The risk is look-alike sites and unverified listings, not the company: on Trustpilot, the profile that points to starlink.com is “Starlink Development”, and if you buy the kit elsewhere, check the seller against Starlink's list of authorized retailers before you pay.

New customers can get a $100 bill credit in the US or £40 in the UK. Open our referral link before you order, check that the reward is shown, and keep your eligible subscription paid and active for two full billing cycles.

contentSections.heading: Who Starlink is and where it sells
paragraphs: Starlink sells through its official site. The order page on starlink.com shows the plan, the kit, the tax and the contract term for your address before you pay.
Our analysis of [when Starlink is worth it](/en/reviews/is-starlink-worth-it) shows how to compare price, installation and alternatives at your address.

contentSections.heading: How to recognize the official site
paragraphs: Type starlink.com into your browser. Before you enter any details or pay, check that you are still on starlink.com.
Check plan, kit (rent or buy), tax and contract term in the order for your own address. If anyone asks you to pay by message or outside the order page, confirm with Starlink support before you go on.

One simple way to avoid a wrong address is to open the order through a referral link: it goes straight to the order on starlink.com, and you still check the address bar before typing any details. The price is the same as on the official site, and the referral only counts if the order starts from a referral link, before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Messages that use the Starlink name
paragraphs: Starlink's help center has a notice on phishing. If an ad or a message in Starlink's name reaches you, confirm on starlink.com before you pay or give any data. If it leads to another address, enter nothing and open the site again by typing the address yourself.

contentSections.heading: Look-alike profiles with the Starlink name
paragraphs: On Trustpilot, the profile for starlink.com is called “Starlink Development”. Other profiles use the name too, with different domains, such as ukstarlink.com and starlink.om. They are not starlink.com. Judge the company by the profile that points to starlink.com.

contentSections.heading: Retailers and marketplaces
paragraphs: Starlink keeps a list of authorized retailers. Even on a well-known marketplace, check who the seller of the listing is.
The [Starlink referral](/en/coupons/starlink) applies to eligible orders placed through the link directly on starlink.com. It cannot be added to a kit bought at a retailer.

contentSections.heading: What Trustpilot shows
paragraphs: On Trustpilot, the starlink.com profile has a TrustScore of 1.6 out of 5 from 879 reviews: 71% are 1-star and 17% are 5-star. The profile is unclaimed, so Starlink has not taken it over, and it has replied to 0% of the reviews.

We read the 40 most recent 1-star and the 40 most recent 5-star reviews. In the 1-star ones, the most common complaints are support that is only a bot or chat (about 1 in 3), dropouts and slow speeds (about 1 in 3), a monthly price that rose after signing up (about 1 in 4), billing and hard cancellations (about 1 in 4), installers from partner companies who are late or do not show (about 1 in 4) and a late or missing kit (about 1 in 5). The 5-star ones praise speed and stability (about half), easy setup (about 1 in 3) and having no other good internet option (about 1 in 4). The counts are ours and approximate.

Read the score with care: an unclaimed profile sends no invitations after a purchase, and people who open one are often there to complain. Praise is about the signal, complaints are about support, price and billing, and few 1-star reviews say the signal is bad all the time. Trustpilot's automatic summary, based on 355 recent reviews, points the same way. Our [full reading of the Trustpilot profile](/en/reviews/starlink-trustpilot-reviews) has the numbers.

contentSections.heading: Checklist before you pay
paragraphs: Five quick checks work for any address and take a few minutes.

checklist.title: Before you place the order
items: I opened the order through the referral link, in the same browser window, so the referral counts.
I checked that the address bar stays on starlink.com before typing any details.
I ran the Starlink app's obstruction check at the spot planned for the dish, to confirm an open sky.
I read the plan, the kit, the total and the contract term on the order summary.
I saved a screenshot of the summary with the monthly price and the 30-day rule before paying.

contentSections.heading: What to keep after you buy
paragraphs: Once the order is placed, a record of what you agreed to settles most disputes.
bullets: Keep the order number, the price shown at checkout and the confirmation email. If something does not match, contact support through the website or the app.
contentSections.emphasis: From what the official site and the retailer list show, for anyone about to buy the kit, the safe choice is to order on starlink.com or from a listed retailer and keep the order number, the checkout price and the confirmation email, because neither route asks for payment outside the order.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Starlink have a coupon? No. Starlink has no coupon code: through Cecília's referral link, a new subscriber gets US$ 100 in the US (£ 40 in the UK) after two months of service, as a credit on the bill, and the person who referred gets the same amount.

Is Starlink legit? Yes, Starlink is SpaceX's official satellite internet service. To buy safely, check that you are on starlink.com, or verify the seller on Starlink's list of authorized retailers before you pay.
What is the official Starlink website? The official site is starlink.com.
How do I confirm that a seller is authorized? See the Starlink list of authorized retailers and check who the seller of the listing is before you pay.

Should I buy on the official site or from a retailer? On starlink.com the order shows plan, kit, tax and contract for your address before you pay, and the referral only works there. A retailer on the official list is a legitimate seller, but the referral does not apply.
